limitation: Recall is at noise level and this is a modelling confound, not a tuning issue: healthy and faulty score distributions overlap almost exactly (means ~0.48 vs ~0.51) across max_samples 32-256. Cause is drive-cycle load. deviation-from-nominal moves with load (0.25-0.8) by roughly the same magnitude degradation moves it, so a hard-working healthy vehicle is indistinguishable from a lightly-worn idle one. Fixing it needs load-conditioned features (residuals after regressing out drive cycle), not different hyperparameters. Do NOT put this number on a slide.
note: M2 (supervised, 97% acc) is the detector the demo relies on. The same IsolationForest technique DOES work on the agent side in app/ueba/baseline.py, which is the UEBA Layer B story.
